name: Lithium chloride eluate
description: A saleable intermediate containing concentrated lithium chloride after adsorption, washing and acid elution.

name: Lithium carbonate
description: A refined lithium salt precipitated from eluate with soda ash; sodium chloride is produced as a coproduct.

name: Lithium hydroxide monohydrate
description: A higher-value battery chemical made by causticising lithium carbonate with hydrated lime; hot caustic service requires containment.

name: Magnesium hydroxide cake
description: A low-value mineral cake recovered during brine pretreatment; sale requires an assay within the buyer's impurity limits.

name: Calcium carbonate cake
description: A low-value mineral coproduct from lithium hydroxide conversion, suitable for mineral filler or neutralisation markets.
